# Bridges Sober Living Apartments

> > Bridges Recovery provides structured sober living homes across California, Arizona, and nationwide with mentoring, medication monitoring, and comprehensive recovery support services.

Bridges Sober Living Apartments (operated by Bridges Recovery) offers transitional housing for individuals in addiction recovery, featuring amenities like one-on-one mentoring, substance-free environments, and proximity to essential services. The site includes location directories across multiple states and educational resources on recovery topics including relapse prevention, cravings management, and sobriety trends.
